def decide(recipient_reputation, round_num, my_history):
    # Threshold starts lower and rises faster, capped at 0.4.
    threshold = -0.1 + 0.03 * round_num
    threshold = min(threshold, 0.4)
    # Own history adjustment: increase trust if cooperated more often, decrease if defected more.
    own_coops = sum(1 for (_, act, _) in my_history if act == 'cooperate')
    own_defects = len(my_history) - own_coops
    # Bias threshold downwards (more trusting) when own cooperation ratio is high.
    if len(my_history) > 0:
        coop_ratio = own_coops / len(my_history)
        # Lower threshold when own cooperation is above 60%, raise when below 40%.
        if coop_ratio > 0.6:
            threshold -= 0.1
        elif coop_ratio < 0.4:
            threshold += 0.1
    return recipient_reputation > threshold
